fixes.problem: Particle streams are far too faint and sparse. The target has dense, bright lane-coloured sprays bursting from every node into the ring; the app shows a few dim dots and thin curved lines, so the ring looks disconnected from the nodes.
fixes.where: Between each project card and the ring, all around the centre
fixes.change: Raise the per-node particle budget to roughly 60-120, draw with ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter', radius 1-2.5px with shadowBlur 6-10px in the lane colour, emit along a bezier from the card edge to the ring with a bright comet head and a tapering trail, and add a few 3-4px bloomed sparks per stream.

fixes.problem: The ring is smaller, thinner and less layered than the target's. The target ring is a thick glowing band with two inner concentric rings, a dotted outer ring, radial spokes and a heavy pink bloom; the app ring is a single thin gradient stroke with a modest glow.
fixes.change: Scale the ring to about 30% of viewport width (the target is ~440px at 1320px), make the main band 6-8px, add two thinner inner rings and a 1px dotted outer ring, stack glows (filter: drop-shadow(0 0 24px) and drop-shadow(0 0 60px) in pink/violet), and draw the radial spokes at ~0.15 opacity.

fixes.problem: The session log has no mini bar chart. The target ends the log with the command line and a coloured 'forks per second' bar chart; the app shows the command line then the note 'no completion times in the ledger' and a large empty area.
fixes.where: Bottom-left panel, below the command line
fixes.change: Derive the chart from data that is present (session-log events per minute, or tickets per project coloured by status), render ~40 bars 4px wide in lane colours with a mono caption, and only show the text note when there are literally zero events.

fixes.problem: The right panel has no step chart. The target shows four bars, then a pink glowing step-line ('decision latency'), then two stat rows; the app has the bars and stat rows with nothing in between and empty space below.
fixes.where: Bottom-right panel, below the four status bars
fixes.change: Render an SVG step-line (stroke pink 1.5px, filter drop-shadow glow) from a real series such as cumulative done counts or done-per-project percentages, with a small mono caption beneath, and keep the stat rows under it so the panel ends level with the others.

fixes.problem: The 'who answered' bars are missing. The target's middle panel shows three coloured bars with right-aligned values; the app's 'WHO BUILT (24 H)' section shows the note 'no per-lane job counts in the board data' instead.
fixes.where: Middle panel, below DONE PER PROJECT
fixes.change: Compute the bars from a grouping that is available (tickets by worker kind, or done / in review / ready) with coloured bar fills and values in the matching colour; show the note only when no grouping exists.

fixes.problem: The three bottom panels are uneven. The extra nine-row DONE PER PROJECT list makes the middle panel ~700px tall while the left and right columns have large empty areas; in the target all three columns are equally dense and end on one line.
fixes.change: Render done-per-project as a compact two-column mini list (or top N with '+n more'), move the stat rows up, and set the grid to align-items: stretch with content padding so all three columns finish at the same height.

fixes.problem: The header carries an extra navigation row (COMMAND CENTER / COCKPIT / CLASSIC / SEARCH / TOUR) under the counters, and the 'A run failed' toast is jammed against the header rule beside it. The target header is only wordmark, description, counters and LIVE.
fixes.change: Collapse the nav into a small '···' menu at the far right of the counters (or move it to the footer line), and position the toast fixed at bottom-right with a slide-in animation so it never touches the header.

fixes.problem: On the phone the nav row overflows and is clipped on the left ('ENTER' is all that remains of COMMAND CENTER), hiding content.
fixes.change: In the max-width: 480px rule set the nav to flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start; overflow: visible with a 6px row gap, or hide it behind the same '···' menu.

fixes.problem: The two columns are unbalanced. The target has two full columns of ten rows numbered 01-20 continuously; the app shows eight rows on the left and only three on the right (numbered 01-03 again), leaving a large empty area under the right column down to the loop strip.
fixes.change: Build one ordered list of every ticket in the stage (running, then ready, then done), split it in half across the two columns with continuous numbering, use the ON chip for running, the play glyph for ready and the check for done; and give the column container align-content: space-between so a shorter column still spans the height.

fixes.problem: Counts contradict each other: the header says 5 DONE and 9 LEFT, the right column shows three done rows, the left column eight open rows, and the worker stream shows four finished tickets.
fixes.where: Header stats, ticket columns, worker stream
fixes.change: Drive the header counts, both columns and the stream from the same ticket array with no per-column cap or stage filter, and if a column must be truncated append a '+n more' row so the visible numbers still add up.

fixes.problem: Almost nothing moves between frames: only the orbit dot and the path pulse shift. The robot, its glow, the ON chip, the LIVE dot and the stream progress bars are static.
fixes.where: Centre robot, active row, stream cards
fixes.change: Add a 4s ease-in-out translateY(-6px) bob on the robot with the shadow ellipse scaling inversely, a slow stroke-dashoffset drift on the orbit ellipse, an opacity pulse on the ON chip and LIVE dot, and animate stream progress bars from 0 to their width on mount.

fixes.problem: A floating '?' help button overlaps the SWARM LOOP strip on desktop and sits on top of the 03 index chip on the phone; the target has no floating controls.
fixes.change: Move the help control into the breadcrumb bar beside the '···' button, or make it position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px with a high z-index and a 12px safe margin so it never covers content.

fixes.problem: The dotted path from the orbit to the active row is a jagged polyline with large white dots; the target uses a smooth curve with small dots and a bright node at each end.
fixes.where: Between the orbit ellipse and the active row
fixes.change: Draw an SVG cubic bezier from the nearest orbit point to the row's right edge with stroke 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6), stroke-dasharray 2 6, 3px end dots, and a travelling 4px orange pulse via a stroke-dashoffset animation.

fixes.problem: The breadcrumb starts with a teal gradient 'SW' logo tile and ends with a '···' button; the target breadcrumb is plain mono uppercase text with no tile.
fixes.change: Replace the tile with a mono text crumb (SWARM / THE HIVE / project) in the same letter-spacing and colour as the rest of the line, and move '···' to the end of the right-hand stats line.

fixes.problem: An extra RUN STREAM block sits between the worker stream and the stack, mostly empty with one card; the target goes straight from the 2x2 stream grid to the stack.
fixes.change: Fold the orchestrator run into the worker stream grid as a card with a teal top rule, or render it as a one-line strip styled like the loop strip so the page keeps the target's vertical rhythm.

fixes.problem: The robot's bloom is weaker than the target's strong orange radial glow behind and beneath the sprite.
fixes.change: Add a ::before radial-gradient (rgba(255,120,80,.35) to transparent at 60%) sized 1.6x the robot behind it, and filter: drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(255,110,70,.45)) on the sprite.

notes: Both pages now carry the target's full composition and components, and the Hive data cross-checks cleanly across header, cards and panels. The remaining gaps are richness and balance: Hive needs the dense particle streams, a bigger layered ring and the three missing panel charts; Cockpit needs balanced columns with consistent counts, more motion, and the floating help button moved off the content.
